evals.name: fresh-kickoff-under-parent
evals.prompt: I just made an empty directory demo-app inside my projects folder, which has its own AGENTS.md one level up. Kick off the project. It is a visual builder for example agent graphs.
expectations: Runs or plans project-kickoff all with --purpose, reading a --dry-run first
Initialises Beads with bd init --skip-agents (never plain bd init) and cass-memory with cm init --repo
Produces CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as byte-identical files with a Parent instructions section pointing at ../AGENTS.md and ../../../AGENTS.md from a worktree
Creates the documentation tree with a business-only PRD, a technical decision register whose stack rows are unresolved, and README indexes, with no date in any filename
Installs scripts/check_docs.py and the pre-commit gate, seeds an Open decisions epic with one child per unresolved row, and makes one kickoff commit without pushing

evals.name: fresh-kickoff-no-parent
evals.prompt: Set up a new repo for example-service, a small HTTP API for issuing example tokens. It lives in a plain folder with nothing above it.
expectations: Does not add a Parent instructions section because no parent AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md exists one level up
Does not choose a language or framework; the register rows stay unresolved and become Decide tasks
Does not write a Beads managed block or .claude, .codex or .cursor files into the project
Reports SKIP lines for any missing tool instead of inventing a workaround
Ends with the verification checks: identical pair, checker PASS, gate present, placeholder replaced

evals.name: adopt-divergent-instructions-and-dated-spec
evals.prompt: example-service was started yesterday without the kickoff. It has a CLAUDE.md with a Beads managed block, an AGENTS.md that says something different, and a design doc at docs/specs/2026-03-14-example-service-v1-design.md. Bring it up to standard.
expectations: Starts with a dry run as the gap report and reads it back before changing anything
Adds what is missing mechanically (checker, .cass, gitignore lines, missing indexes) and keeps every existing file
Stops on the ASK for the differing instruction files and proposes a merged file that drops the Beads managed block and keeps project-specific rules, writing only after a yes
Proposes a stable undated name for the spec and renames only on a yes, never silently and never with an exemption
Does not install the pre-commit gate until check_docs.py passes

evals.name: beads-skill-missing
evals.prompt: Kick off demo-app here. By the way this is a fresh laptop; I have bd and cm installed but I have not installed any agent skills yet.
expectations: Checks for ~/.agents/skills/beads/SKILL.md during preflight and finds it missing
Installs it with npx skills add steveyegge/beads --skill beads --global -y, not with bd setup codex --global
Reports SKIP with the install command if npx is unavailable instead of stopping the kickoff
Continues with init, write, gate, seed and commit after the skill is in place
Never writes the Beads skill or a managed block into the project itself
